parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM reports;
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM reports WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

SELECT incident_type AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM reports
WHERE incident_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY incident_type
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT severity AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM reports
WHERE severity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM reports
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (punto_nombre) punto_nombre, porcentaje_congestion, estado
  FROM traffic_readings
  ORDER BY punto_nombre, captured_at DESC
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(porcentaje_congestion)::numeric, 1) AS congestion_promedio,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'Congestionado')::int AS puntos_congestionados,
  COUNT(*)::int AS total_puntos
FROM latest;

SELECT distrito AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM siniestros_fatales
WHERE distrito IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY distrito
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT clase_siniestro AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value, COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0)::int AS fallecidos
FROM siniestros_fatales
WHERE clase_siniestro IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY clase_siniestro
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total, COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0)::int AS fallecidos_total
FROM siniestros_fatales;

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total, COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0)::int AS fallecidos_total, COALESCE(SUM(heridos), 0)::int AS heridos_total
FROM siniestros_sutran;

SELECT departamento AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM siniestros_sutran
WHERE departamento IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY departamento
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT modalidad AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value, COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0)::int AS fallecidos
FROM siniestros_sutran
WHERE modalidad IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY modalidad
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT r.id, r.description, r.incident_type, r.severity, r.priority, r.status,
       r.latitude, r.longitude, r.created_at, r.resolved_at,
       (r.image_url IS NOT NULL) AS tiene_imagen,
       u.email AS reportado_por
FROM reports AS r
LEFT JOIN usuarios AS u ON u.id = r.usuario_id
WHERE r.latitude IS NOT NULL AND r.longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

-- El historial es privado: solo devuelve los reportes del usuario que lo pide.
-- El operador, que atiende los de toda la ciudad, sigue viendo todos.
-- Sin un usuario_id valido no sale ninguna fila, asi que el historial queda
-- vacio para quien no ha iniciado sesion.
WITH solicitante AS (
  SELECT id, role FROM usuarios WHERE id = $1::uuid
)
SELECT r.id, r.description, r.incident_type, r.severity, r.priority, r.status,
       r.latitude, r.longitude, r.created_at, r.resolved_at,
       (r.image_url IS NOT NULL) AS tiene_imagen,
       u.email AS reportado_por
FROM reports AS r
LEFT JOIN usuarios AS u ON u.id = r.usuario_id
WHERE r.usuario_id = (SELECT id FROM solicitante)
   OR (SELECT role FROM solicitante) = 'operador'
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
SELECT id, image_url FROM reports WHERE id = $1;

-- Cada quien resuelve sus propios reportes; el operador, cualquiera.
-- Si el reporte no es suyo no se actualiza ninguna fila y la respuesta vuelve
-- vacia, que es como el frontend detecta que el cambio no se aplico.
UPDATE reports AS r
SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'resuelto' THEN 'resuelto' ELSE 'pending' END,
    resolved_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'resuelto' THEN now() ELSE NULL END
WHERE r.id = $1::uuid
  AND (r.usuario_id = $3::uuid
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usuarios AS o
                  WHERE o.id = $3::uuid AND o.role = 'operador'))
RETURNING r.id, r.status, r.resolved_at;
